beats.title: The huge meat chamber and the enemy layout are revealed
beats.summary: The party enters a vast chamber centered on a giant meat mound over churning water. Cultists feed themselves into it, and the group backs up to count the defenders: cultist leaders, elite guards, regular guards, meat monsters, and wall-tendrils, just before the tunnel contracts and throws them into battle.

beats.title: Opening volley: fireball, ambush kills, and a fall from the walkway
beats.summary: The battle begins with Caelynn detonating a Fireball scroll on the center platform, heavily damaging cult leaders and killing two elite guards. Bonogo follows with a lethal strike and a push off the walkway, then Caelynn survives a grappling tumble by using Featherfall and Tempestuous Magic while Karsemine finishes a guard with scimitars.

Bonogo uses his chance to leap back over to one of the Elite Guards by the tunnel and stabs him for massive damage before throwing him off the walkway to the depths below.
